messages.content: First call AGUISendStateSnapshot with snapshot {"todos":["buy milk"]}. Then call AGUISendStateDelta to add "walk dog" at /todos/-. Then call AGUISendStateDelta again to add "post letter" at /todos/-. Then say done.
